from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single extracted financial data point for Current Assets from one document."""
    company: Literal["Arvana Inc"] = Field(description="The company name derived from the task")
    metric: Literal["Current Assets"] = Field(description="The financial line item name derived from the task")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the reported value belongs to, as found in the document")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The reported value as text from the document")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit or scale mentioned in the document, if any")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_points: list[FinancialDataPoint] = Field(description="All extracted Current Assets records from the provided documents")
